title: When a star switches on
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: A main-sequence star sustains hydrogen fusion in its core. The energy released supports the hot star against gravitational collapse for a long period.

misconception: A learner may choose: The first formation of any dust
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: What marks the beginning of a star's main-sequence life?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: What marks the beginning of a star's main-sequence life? Sustained hydrogen fusion in its core. A main-sequence star sustains hydrogen fusion in its core. The energy released supports the hot star against gravitational collapse for a long period.
Visual caption: Core hydrogen fusion begins. The SVG is a conceptual illustration, not measured data or a scale model.

recall.question: What marks the beginning of a star's main-sequence life?
options: The first formation of any dust
The end of all gravitational attraction
Sustained hydrogen fusion in its core
recall.why: A main-sequence star sustains hydrogen fusion in its core. The energy released supports the hot star against gravitational collapse for a long period.
